name: Speaker Display — Occupancy Capacity Warning
description: Every 30 seconds, check AOA occupancy. When 20 or more people are detected, show a capacity warning on the speaker-display screen. The message stays on screen while the space remains over capacity and clears automatically when occupancy drops below the threshold.

actions.message:
⚠ At Capacity: {{aoa_human}} people
Please wait outside until space is available.
